card.name: Modifier words before an acting or prolonging drug term
card.fires_on: The word "rapidly" in "dosage of rapidly acting corticosteroids" or "or rapidly acting" agents. Also "That" or "that" in drug-interaction headings such as "Drugs That Prolong QT".
